event: Determine the speaker's location (left, right, or back) relative to a robot standing by the stainless steel refrigerator and facing the double-basin rectangular sink, when the speech topic is 'announcing location of items'.

sounding_object.description: Adult male, wearing a teal/blue short-sleeved polo shirt and khaki shorts. He has dark hair and is wearing glasses. Average build.

reference_object.description: Large, stainless steel, side-by-side refrigerator with water/ice dispenser. Located against the wall to the right of the kitchen island (when viewed from the living room area).

facing_object.description: Stainless steel double-basin rectangular sink with a gooseneck style tap. It is inset into the kitchen island countertop, towards the left side of the island (when viewed from the living room area).

question: Imagine you are a robot standing by the stainless steel refrigerator and facing the double-basin rectangular sink and tap, when the speech topic: "announcing location of items" comes up, relative to where you are facing, where is the speaker: left, right, or back? If the object is generally to your left and facing it requires turning less than 120 degrees left, choose 'left'. If the object is generally to your right and facing it requires turning less than 120 degrees right, choose 'right'. If the object is generally behind you and facing it requires turning 120 degrees or more, choose 'back'.
